method: UTF-8 bytes; Unicode characters; characters/4 estimate. Deterministic source accounting, not runtime latency or observed host context.

mode_initial_read_set.scope: Mode entry and unconditional adapters only, before reply or task-dependent reads. See initial_mode_routing for the route announcement closure.

native_frontmatter.scope: All 50 declared frontmatter blocks, an upper bound; actual native startup exposure is unknown.

codex_policy_metadata.scope: Additional policy-file bytes, not a claim these files enter model context.

canonical_skill_bodies.scope: Whole native SKILL.md files, metadata included; separate from invocation closure.

bug_fix.scenario: One local CLI logic defect in one Python function, simple how, one source-control why category, cheap existing regression target; one scoped implementation worker; no defensive-code investigation, function-boundary change, comment findings, retries or mobile work. Includes the full Opening a PR contract and its preparatory guidance. External publication is modeled only, never executed.

larger_feature.scenario: One TypeScript CLI feature with repeatable state transitions spanning three modules in one existing subsystem. Complex how runs in Feature and Architect, two exploration angles each. One design arena and one implementation arena, each three candidates and one judge. No ownership redesign, contested design, retries, comment findings, mobile work or unattended program. Includes full Opening a PR contract and preparatory guidance. A genuinely large/cross-cutting migration requires figure-it-out and a task-designed closure, not this fixed profile.

worker_accounting: Unique inventory deduplicates paths across contexts; it is not a workflow token total. Record fixed worker counts separately and a floor for the mandatory fresh mode-worker read set. This floor excludes their additional skills, role inputs and generated evidence, and is not additive to the unique inventory.
limits: No runtime host, tokenizer, prompt framing, cache or native invocation observation.
Required transitive bundled reads are included for the stated scenarios even if invocation would hold.
External skills, consumer inputs and generated evidence have unknown size; no complete workflow token total is claimed.
Unique inventories do not count repeated loads in fresh workers; the separate floor is partial and not additive.
Mobile, investigation categories, retries and task-designed large programs require different closures.
Static scenario accounting needs review when instructions or assumptions change.
